definitions.gloss: event; category; item (in sports, competitions, etc.)
definitions.explanation: One of the individual events or categories that make up a sporting competition, examination, or set of activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な{種目|しゅもく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧だ。
⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種目|しゅもく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧{種目|しゅもく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I can't decide which event to enter at the sports day.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (kind, type) + {目|もく} (item, category). Refers to an individual event or category within a larger competition or program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧{種目|しゅもく}: a competitive event
- {種目|しゅもく}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: by event; per category
- ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧{種目|しゅもく}: an official event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧: a sporting event; competition — emphasizes the contest itself, while {種目|しゅもく} emphasizes its place as one category among several
